faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: RinKuzu is an AI-powered personalized learning platform that transforms PDF documents into personalized quiz-based learning journeys using knowledge graphs and Bloom's Taxonomy.
faq.q2: How do I generate a quiz from a PDF?
faq.a2: Upload supported PDF material and RinKuzu extracts concepts, identifies prerequisite context, and generates quizzes with explanations.
faq.a3: Yes. Free includes 5 PDF-to-quiz generations per month (up to 30 pages per file), 2 personalized learning paths per month, 50 personalized exercises per day, and 25 Ask Rin-chan messages per day. Premium unlocks the full curated Quiz Premium catalog and raises these limits. Free accounts can unlock individual Premium quizzes with credits earned from approved contributions.
faq.a4: RinKuzu supports Vietnamese and English with a full bilingual interface. Switch languages anytime using the language switcher in the navigation.
faq.q5: What is a knowledge graph in learning?
faq.a5: A knowledge graph maps relationships between concepts in your material. RinKuzu builds a visual graph showing prerequisite chains so you can see the learning path from fundamentals to advanced topics.
faq.q6: What is Bloom's Taxonomy and how does RinKuzu use it?
faq.a6: Bloom's Taxonomy classifies cognitive levels from Remember to Create. RinKuzu uses these levels to vary the kinds of practice questions it generates.
faq.q7: How does personalized learning work on RinKuzu?
faq.a7: RinKuzu uses Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) to represent practice performance and prioritize questions for concepts marked as weak. The AI adjusts question difficulty dynamically.
faq.q8: Can I share my quizzes with others?
faq.a8: Yes! Set your quizzes to public to share with friends, classmates, or the RinKuzu community. Browse the Explore page for quizzes created by other users.
faq.q9: What types of questions does RinKuzu generate?
faq.a9: RinKuzu generates multiple-choice questions across Bloom's Taxonomy levels and includes generated explanations for review.
faq.q10: Does RinKuzu work on mobile devices?
faq.a10: Yes. RinKuzu has an installable Progressive Web App manifest and a responsive web experience for desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.
faq.a11: Currently PDF documents are supported. Support for Word docs, PowerPoint slides, and plain text is on our roadmap.
faq.q12: How is my data and privacy protected?
faq.a12: Uploaded PDFs are processed to generate your learning content. A quiz is shared publicly only when you choose to publish it publicly. See our Privacy Policy for details about data processing and storage.
faq.q13: What is the AI tutor Rin-chan?
faq.a13: Rin-chan is RinKuzu's built-in AI assistant for explanations, follow-up questions, and guidance through practice topics.
faq.q14: How do I track my learning progress?
faq.a14: The Dashboard shows your mastery level per concept, accuracy trends, weak topics, and completion rates. Bookmark quizzes for later and review your history anytime.
faq.q15: Can teachers use RinKuzu for classroom assessment?
faq.a15: Yes. Teachers can turn lecture PDFs into quizzes and share public quizzes with students. Classroom management and class-wide analytics are not currently available.
